name: ai-website-clone-template
description: Clone any website into a clean, modern Next.js codebase using AI coding agents
author: JCodesMore

scripts.dev: node -e "const path=require('node:path'); const {spawn}=require('node:child_process'); const cwd=process.cwd(); const root=path.basename(cwd)==='standalone' && path.basename(path.dirname(cwd))==='.next' ? path.resolve(cwd,'..','..') : cwd; const child=spawn(process.execPath,[path.join(root,'node_modules','next','dist','bin','next'),'dev',root],{stdio:'inherit'}); child.on('exit',(code,signal)=>process.exit(code ?? (signal ? 1 : 0)));"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build
